## Description {#details}

<p>Empty base struct for the framework expression types.</p>


<p>The <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/op">op</a></span> struct is the common base of the comparators defined in <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail-h">detail.h</a></span>, of <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/floating-point-constant">floating_point_constant</a></span>, and of <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/named-bool">named_bool</a></span>. It provides the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/op/#a384b1d115e493d6a554ebda4e3089b19">op_type</a></span> marker, which the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/concepts/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/extension/is-op">extension::is_op</a></span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/concepts/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/extension/any-op">extension::any_op</a></span> concepts use to distinguish the framework types from the user types, so that <span class="doxyComputerOutput">expect()</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">require()</span>, and the operators in the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/operators">operators</a></span> namespace accept them.</p>


<p>The types that must not have an empty base, like <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/value-base">value_base</a></span>, declare the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/op/#a384b1d115e493d6a554ebda4e3089b19">op_type</a></span> marker directly instead of deriving from <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/op">op</a></span>.</p>


<p>Definition at line 112 of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/values-h">values.h</a>.</p>
